inputs.prompt: Redesign this SINGLE pictured woman as the final Gumiho boss reveal. There must be EXACTLY ONE WOMAN, ONE HEAD, ONE FACE, TWO ARMS and TWO FEET. Her ordinary work clothes remain completely unchanged. Keep her three-quarter turned-away pose and small open-handed beckoning gesture, but intensify the expression: an intimate, knowing half-smile and direct amber gaze that quietly lures the viewer toward her. Behind this ONE woman, exactly NINE separate enormous fox tails unfold from her lower back like a living fan, black smoky fur at their bases and worn pale-gold at their tips. Give each tail a distinct contour and dark space between tails. The dramatic contrast is an utterly mundane Joseon village woman against a terrifying nine-tailed silhouette; NO queen costume, armor, regalia, crown or added jewelry. Make a SINGLE vertically composed full-length game concept art illustration. Place the figure small enough that the ENTIRE head, both shoes and all tail tips remain INSIDE the frame with breathing room. Matte painterly Korean dark-fantasy illustration compatible with the uploaded style, grounded cloth construction for future 3D modeling, charcoal background, restrained ember rim light, very little foxfire. No portrait inset, no duplicate person, no phantom second face, no attached extra head, no multiple panels, no text or labels, no exposed skin, no Western/Chinese/Japanese fantasy costume, no cute fox ears.
